plan.title: Add surrogate bid on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Participants tab as the buyer.
Find Vendor A's participant row before adding the surrogate bid.
Verify Vendor A is present and eligible for a surrogate bid.
Enter and submit a surrogate bid of 95 for Vendor A.
Verify the bid submission was accepted.
Verify Responses shows Vendor A's bid and identifies it as a surrogate response.
Open the comparison grid to verify the submitted bid is counted in Master QCS.
Verify Master QCS contains Vendor A's real vendor column.
Verify Master QCS shows the surrogate bid rate of 95.
